run_test_interoperability: run an async gRPC aio interoperability test case by TestCase enum against a TestServiceStub
test_empty_unary: test that an empty unary gRPC call returns an empty_pb2.Empty response via the stub
test_client_streaming: test client-side streaming by sending multiple payload requests and verifying aggregated payload size
test_server_streaming: test server-side streaming by requesting multiple responses and validating each payload type and length
test_custom_metadata: test sending and receiving custom initial and trailing metadata on unary and full duplex gRPC calls
